editor_summary: Sample briefing. This illustrative day shows an open-weights release and a research claim, both of which the editor would rank by severity and credibility before emailing.

signals.headline: Example: an open-weights model released under a permissive license
signals.summary: Illustrative sample entry, not a real event. A hypothetical lab publishes weights that score close to paid frontier APIs.
signals.why_it_matters: A free model that is good enough can pull spend away from paid APIs.

signals.headline: Example: a preprint claiming a large training-efficiency gain
signals.summary: Illustrative sample entry, not a real event. A hypothetical paper reports similar accuracy with a fraction of the training compute.
signals.why_it_matters: If it replicates, future training clusters could be smaller than planned.

signals.headline: Example: a quantization toolkit that halves serving memory
signals.summary: Illustrative sample entry, not a real event. A hypothetical open-source tool lets models run in less memory with little quality loss.
signals.why_it_matters: Lower memory needs stretch existing hardware further.

signals.headline: Example: an accelerator benchmark result awaiting independent review
signals.summary: Illustrative sample entry, not a real event. A hypothetical vendor posts a benchmark that has not been reproduced yet.
signals.why_it_matters: Worth watching until a third party confirms it.
